about: Topics (Steve, 2026-10-28): every demo on the site sorted by subject, for anyone browsing outside a course. tools/courses.py builds topics/<id>.html from this list and the home page's All demos by topic area. Every demo in curriculum/catalog.json must be in at least one topic; a demo may be in several. Courses, the textbook map and demo addresses do not depend on this file.

topics.title: Kinematics
topics.blurb: Position, velocity and acceleration, projectiles and circular motion.

topics.title: Forces and Newton's laws
topics.blurb: Free body diagrams, friction, apparent weight and drag.

topics.title: Energy and momentum
topics.blurb: Work, potential energy, collisions and rockets.

topics.title: Rotation
topics.blurb: Torque, moment of inertia, rolling and precession.

topics.title: Equilibrium and materials
topics.blurb: Static equilibrium, stress and strain, hanging chains.

topics.title: Gravitation and orbits
topics.blurb: Newton's gravity, Kepler's laws, tides and orbital resonance.

topics.title: Fluids
topics.blurb: Pressure, buoyancy, flow and viscosity.

topics.title: Oscillations and waves
topics.blurb: Springs and pendulums, waves on strings, interference in a ripple tank.

topics.title: Sound and acoustics
topics.blurb: Speed of sound, loudness, resonance, timbre, Doppler and ultrasound.

topics.title: Heat and thermodynamics
topics.blurb: Temperature, gases, heat engines, entropy and radiation.

topics.title: Charges and fields
topics.blurb: Coulomb's law, field lines, Gauss's law, capacitors.

topics.title: Circuits
topics.blurb: Resistance, DC and RC circuits, household wiring, transformers.

topics.title: Magnetism
topics.blurb: Forces on charges and currents, fields of currents, magnetic materials.

topics.title: Induction and EM waves
topics.blurb: Faraday's law, eddy currents, displacement current and light as a wave.

topics.title: Optics
topics.blurb: Mirrors and lenses, the eye, microscopes and telescopes, polarization.

topics.title: Interference and diffraction
topics.blurb: Slits, gratings, thin films, interferometers, resolution and holograms.

topics.title: Relativity
topics.blurb: Spacetime diagrams, time dilation, relativistic momentum and energy.

topics.title: Photons and quanta
topics.blurb: Photoelectric effect, Compton scattering, matter waves and wave packets.

topics.title: Atoms, molecules and solids
topics.blurb: Orbitals, spectra, spin, X-rays, lasers, bands and superconductors.

topics.title: Nuclear and particle physics
topics.blurb: Decay, binding energy, fission and fusion, gamma spectra, quarks.

topics.title: The sky
topics.blurb: Seasons, the celestial sphere, Moon phases and retrograde motion.

topics.title: Telescopes and light
topics.blurb: Collecting and resolving light, the spectrum and what it tells us.

topics.title: Planets and the solar system
topics.blurb: Formation, temperatures, interiors, craters, giant planets and exoplanets.

topics.title: Stars
topics.blurb: The HR diagram, inside a star, white dwarfs and black holes.

topics.title: Galaxies and cosmology
topics.blurb: Rotation curves, the distance ladder and the early universe.

topics.title: Radiation in medicine
topics.blurb: Photon and proton interactions, dose, radiobiology, shielding, therapy QA and CT.

topics.title: Chemistry and biology
topics.blurb: An oscillating chemical reaction and the structure of DNA.
